method: Complete owner review: 12 ratings joined to exact recorded first reveals by system, index and input. Same Claude writer, six same-input pairs, one unreplicated sample per version. Input 0 is an explicit owner tone reference and is a direction check, not held-out evidence; inputs 1-5 were fresh. Strength, optional reaction tags, screenshot intent and failure reasons remain separate. Historical reviews are not pooled. New ratings have been recorded but have not yet been incorporated into runtime prompts.
conclusion: The new voice earns two screenshot picks versus zero before, while both versions earn three STRONG ratings. The new version has two MILD and one NONE versus one MILD and two NONE before. Pairwise strength improves on two inputs, declines on one and ties on three. One new output is marked too far. Of the five fresh inputs, the new version earns two STRONG ratings and one screenshot pick versus three STRONG ratings and no screenshot picks before. This supports the roast direction and identifies usable examples; it is not proof of consistent shock or a broad quality win.
